screens.rationale: Cipla's entire cardiac book is Rs 389 Cr. A space must be big enough that a credible 8-10% share adds >=Rs 15 Cr and a realistic ambition moves the needle. Resolves: market size vs growth rate - we require a minimum ABSOLUTE growth pool, so a 90% growth rate on a Rs 20 Cr base does not beat a 20% growth rate on Rs 900 Cr.

Reject pools whose headline growth is price, not patients. Market real growth is computed from the data (MAT CP FEB'26 / MAT FEB'25 - 1). Resolves: growth vs quality-of-growth - DPCO-capped molecules can post double-digit value growth on shrinking volumes; those are harvest assets, not investment cases.

Reject attractive-but-unwinnable. A space qualifies either because Cipla already has position, or because it is one adjacency step from a franchise Cipla owns. Resolves: attractiveness vs right-to-win - attractiveness never overrides winnability.
Reject value traps - spaces facing a structural headwind (price control, guideline de-prioritisation, blocked by originator exclusivity) inside the horizon.
Reject spaces requiring a capability Cipla cannot build in 3-5 years within this franchise (e.g. a biologic-only pool). Barrier is set per cluster in section 2.

clusters.label: Non-statin / residual-risk lipid (ezetimibe, bempedoic, saroglitazar, PCSK9)

signals.label: CSI 2024 dyslipidaemia guidelines: lower LDL-C targets (<70 high-risk, <55 very-high), explicit escalation to oral non-statins then PCSK9i/inclisiran; non-HDL-C target when TG>150
signals.source: CSI Clinical Practice Guidelines for Dyslipidemia Management, Indian Heart Journal 2024 - https://csi.org.in/frontend/assets/assets/CSI-clinical-practice-guidelines-for-dyslipidemia-_240413_141815.pdf

signals.label: ICMR-INDIAB: ~79-81% of Indian adults have at least one lipid abnormality; high TG / low HDL 'Indian dyslipidaemia phenotype' dominates - a triglyceride-led, not LDL-led, problem
signals.source: ICMR-INDIAB, Prevalence of Dyslipidemia in Urban and Rural India (PMC4016101) + ICMR-INDIAB-17, Lancet Diabetes & Endocrinology 2023

signals.label: ICMR-INDIAB-17: hypertension prevalence 35.5% of Indian adults (Lancet D&E 2023); treatment and control rates remain low - volume headroom, not just price
Guideline shift to single-pill combinations as first-line for stage-2 HTN (WHO HEARTS / India Hypertension Control Initiative); SPCs improve adherence and control rates
signals.source: WHO HEARTS technical package; India Hypertension Control Initiative (IHCI) programme reports, ICMR-NCDIR

signals.label: NLEM 2022 scheduled cardiac molecules (incl. amlodipine, atenolol, telmisartan, atorvastatin, enalapril) are DPCO ceiling-priced; annual revision is WPI-linked (~1-2%). Non-scheduled molecules/FDCs price freely (data shows 6-9%)
signals.source: NLEM 2022, MoHFW/CDSCO - https://cdsco.gov.in/opencms/resources/UploadCDSCOWeb/2018/UploadConsumer/nlem2022.pdf ; DPCO 2013 First Schedule; NPPA ceiling price notifications

signals.label: Atenolol de-prioritised as first-line antihypertensive in current hypertension guidelines (ESC/ISH/ACC) except post-MI / rate control; prescriber base is ageing out
signals.source: ESC/ESH 2023 Hypertension Guidelines; ISH 2020 Global Hypertension Practice Guidelines

signals.label: Cilnidipine (N/L-type CCB) preferred in India for reduced pedal oedema, sympathetic modulation and renoprotection vs amlodipine; India+Japan concentrated, so global generic price pressure is structurally low
signals.source: Indian cardiology literature on N/L-type CCBs (JAPI / Indian Heart Journal reviews); market concentration evident in dataset

signals.label: Ambient PM2.5 exposure is an established driver of ischaemic heart disease and hypertension incidence; India carries among the world's highest PM2.5 burdens - structural expansion of the treated cardiac pool
signals.source: Global Burden of Disease / State of Global Air; Lancet Planetary Health India air pollution and CVD analyses

signals.label: Saroglitazar is a Zydus-originated NCE under exclusivity; the segment is real (Rs 538 Cr, +46%) but not addressable by generic entry within the horizon. Read as proof of category demand, not as an entry point
signals.source: Zydus Lifesciences product disclosures; Indian Patent Office filings for saroglitazar

signals.label: Patent/IP landscape: ezetimibe and bempedoic acid are past exclusivity and freely genericisable in India, so the non-statin escalation tier is open NOW. Saroglitazar remains under Zydus originator exclusivity - the category is proven but that molecule is not an entry route inside the horizon
signals.source: CDSCO approval records for ezetimibe / bempedoic acid FDCs; Indian Patent Office filings for saroglitazar. Re-verify with: python signal_agent.py --patent-scan

signals.label: Patent/IP landscape: the legacy antihypertensive and core-statin pools are fully genericised with no exclusivity events left to unlock. No IP-driven upside is available - the only lever left is price, which DPCO caps
signals.source: Absence of live exclusivity in these molecule classes; corroborated in-dataset by 55-169 competitors per subgroup and 0.8-1.4% realised price growth

signals.label: Geopolitical / supply chain: India imports a large majority of bulk drug intermediates and KSMs from China, and cardiovascular APIs (statins, sartans) sit in that exposed set. A supply or tariff shock raises input cost across the cardiac portfolio - and hits hardest where DPCO caps the ability to pass it through
signals.source: Dept. of Pharmaceuticals PLI scheme for bulk drugs / KSMs; Indian pharma API import-dependence reporting. Re-verify with: python signal_agent.py --patent-scan

signals.label: Geopolitical / supply chain: the PLI scheme for bulk drugs is intended to re-shore KSM and API manufacture. Backward-integrated players gain relative cost resilience; the effect is directionally positive but slower than the 3-5 year decision horizon for most molecules
signals.source: Dept. of Pharmaceuticals, Production Linked Incentive scheme for bulk drugs (KSMs / DIs / APIs)

signals.label: Ezetimibe and bempedoic acid are off-patent / freely genericisable in India and are the guideline-mandated first escalation after statins - open, fast-growing, low-barrier entry
signals.source: CDSCO approvals for ezetimibe and bempedoic acid FDCs; CSI 2024 guidelines escalation pathway
